daily.title: One in Three Rio de Janeiro Residents Lives in Area With Gang or Militia Presence, Survey Shows
daily.summary:
Around 5.2 million people, equivalent to nearly one-third of the population of Rio de Janeiro state, live in areas where criminal gangs or militias operate, according to a survey by the ISP (Public Security Institute) released Wednesday (11). The study identified 1,530 areas with a presence of these groups in 2025.

weekly.summary:
